title: [Shopify] Fix customer matching when phone numbers contain spaces
summary: Shopify connector now normalizes phone numbers before search and verifies exact matches when finding existing customers, fixing incorrect duplicates with formatted phone numbers.
key_points: Phone numbers are normalized to digits and plus sign before Shopify search
Search results are validated for exact phone and email matches
GraphQL queries now return phone and email fields for verification
Test coverage added for phone normalization and partial match rejection
quote: Normalize the phone to + and digits before sending it to Shopify
